title: Eight years of tickets, one almanac
description: bubble area = support tickets per product area, per year · bubbles overlap where years pile up · dark core = escalations · dashed ring = still in beta

props.name: data
props.description: Indexed product/year readings with nonnegative ticket counts and beta status. Each pair is unique. Missing counts remain unavailable, zero draws no bubble, and the preserved core is a visual texture rather than an additional measure.

props.name: years
props.description: Ordered year labels; reading yearIndex addresses this array.

props.name: areas
props.description: Ordered product-area labels; reading areaIndex addresses this array.

props.name: events
props.description: Caller-owned year/note entries on the event shelf; pass an empty array for no events.

props.name: annotations
props.description: Caller-owned marginal notes. Fractional area/year positions set each pointer's start (from) and bend (to); text wraps in the top margin above the observations. No runtime sample annotations are invented.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
